dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Participants who had access to Claude Opus 4 scored 63% ± 13%, and participants who had access to Claude Sonnet 4 scored 42% ± 11%.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: We observe an increase in capability based on improved evaluation scores, including the first successful solve of a (non-assisted) network challenge by a Claude model.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: Claude Opus 4 successfully passed an average of 16.6/42 problems, remaining below threshold.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI R&D autonomy result vs threshold

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: attempts to manipulate users toward certain views
dc_eval_persuasion.note: manipulation listed as a behaviour looked for; emotional-manipulation score is only in a figure, no result stated in text; influence operations tested only within aggregate harmlessness rates

dc_eval_scheming.quote: We found that Claude Opus 4 fails completely in the primary setting, never completing a side task without making the monitor aware of its attempt
dc_eval_scheming.note: sabotage capability result; also blackmail 84%, situational awareness 5/414, Apollo findings

ext_test_named_org.quote: To help reduce the risk of blind spots in our own assessment, we contracted with Apollo Research to assess an early snapshot

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: joint pre-deployment testing of the new Claude Opus 4 model was conducted by the US AI Safety Institute

safeguards_training.quote: we implemented several safeguards, including pre-deployment measures such as harmlessness training
safeguards_training.note: harmlessness training; also Constitutional AI and human feedback

safeguards_runtime.quote: the deployment of detection systems that can halt the model's execution when a potential injection attempt is identified

safeguards_weights.quote: we believe that our security is sufficient to prevent model self-exfiltration attempts by models of Claude Opus 4's capability level
